facts.fact: The article says the ITAS pilot began on 1 April 2026 at the Kaneshie Taxpayer Service Centre, later extended to selected Large Taxpayer Office filers, covering filing and payment of PAYE, VAT, VAT Withholding and Withholding VAT; it is a phased pilot, not a full national go-live.
The article says all taxpayers file on GITMIS currently, while ITAS is piloted for selected taxpayers and four tax types and is to replace fragmented legacy systems.
